verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile lets users start Copilot cloud agent tasks and assign issues to Copilot, which then work on their own and return a ready-to-review pull request while progress is tracked from the phone. These are one-off delegated tasks, not configured recurring automations. The scheduled and event-triggered automations (docs-24) and GitHub Actions are documented for the cloud agent and the platform, not as something set up in the mobile app, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of creating scheduled or event-triggered recurring automations from GitHub Mobile, and independent or hands-on corroboration of background agent execution initiated from mobile.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Agent Tasks are now on GitHub Mobile, giving developers a centralized way to manage Copilot cloud agent tasks wherever they are. Easily start new tasks and keep track of progress while you’re on the move.
Assign issues to Copilot and get a ready-to-review pull request.
